/autocomplete: AutoComplete is an input component that provides real-time suggestions when being typed.
/cascadeselect: CascadeSelect is a form component to select a value from a nested structure of options.
/checkbox: Checkbox is an extension to standard checkbox element with theming.
/colorpicker: ColorPicker is an input component to select a color.
/datepicker: DatePicker is a form component for date inputs.
/editor: Editor is rich text editor component based on Quill.
/floatlabel: FloatLabel visually integrates a label with its form element.
/iconfield: IconField wraps an input and an icon.
/iftalabel: IftaLabel is used to create infield top aligned labels
/inputgroup: Text, icon, buttons and other content can be grouped next to an input.
/inputmask: InputMask component is used to enter input in a certain format such as numeric, date, currency, email and phone.
/inputnumber: InputNumber is an input component to provide numerical input.
/inputotp: Input Otp is used to enter one time passwords.
/inputtext: InputText is an extension to standard input element with theming.
/keyfilter: A keyfilter is a directive used to block individual keystrokes based on a pattern.
/knob: Knob is a form component to define number inputs with a dial.
/listbox: Listbox is used to select one or more values from a list of items.
/multiselect: MultiSelect is used to select multiple items from a collection.
/password: Password displays strength indicator for password fields.
/radiobutton: RadioButton is an extension to standard radio button element with theming.
/rating: Rating component is a star based selection input.
/select: Select is used to choose an item from a collection of options.
/selectbutton: SelectButton is used to choose single or multiple items from a list using buttons.
/slider: Slider is a component to provide input with a drag handle.
/textarea: Textarea adds styling and autoResize functionality to standard textarea element.
/togglebutton: ToggleButton is used to select a boolean value using a button.
/toggleswitch: ToggleSwitch is used to select a boolean value.
/treeselect: TreeSelect is a form component to choose from hierarchical data.
/button: Button is an extension to standard input element with icons and theming.
/speeddial: When pressed, a floating action button can display multiple primary actions that can be performed on a page.
/splitbutton: SplitButton groups a set of commands in an overlay with a default command.
/datatable: DataTable displays data in tabular format.
/dataview: DataView displays data in grid or list layout with pagination and sorting features.
/orderlist: OrderList is used to sort a collection.
/paginator: Paginator displays data in paged format and provides navigation between pages.
/picklist: PickList is used to reorder items between different lists.
/timeline: Timeline visualizes a series of chained events.
/tree: Tree is used to display hierarchical data.
/treetable: TreeTable is used to display hierarchical data in tabular format.
/virtualscroller: VirtualScroller is a performant approach to render large amounts of data efficiently.
/accordion: Accordion groups a collection of contents in panels.
/card: Card is a flexible container component.
/deferredcontent: DeferredContent postpones the loading the content that is initially not in the viewport until it becomes visible on scroll.
/divider: Divider is used to separate contents.
/fieldset: Fieldset is a grouping component with a content toggle feature.
/panel: Panel is a grouping component providing with content toggle feature.
/scrollpanel: ScrollPanel is a cross browser, lightweight and skinnable alternative to native browser scrollbar.
/splitter: Splitter is utilized to separate and resize panels.
/stepper: The Stepper component displays a wizard-like workflow by guiding users through the multi-step progression.
/tabs: Tabs facilitates seamless switching between different views.
/toolbar: Toolbar is a grouping component for buttons and other content.
/confirmdialog: ConfirmDialog uses a Dialog UI that is integrated with the Confirmation API.
/confirmpopup: ConfirmPopup displays a confirmation overlay displayed relatively to its target.
/dialog: Dialog is a container to display content in an overlay window.
/drawer: Drawer is a container component displayed as an overlay.
/dynamicdialog: Dialogs can be created dynamically with any component as the content using a DialogService.
/popover: Popover is a container component that can overlay other components on page.
/tooltip: Tooltip directive provides advisory information for a component.
/fileupload: FileUpload is an advanced uploader with dragdrop support, multi file uploads, auto uploading, progress tracking and validations.
/breadcrumb: Breadcrumb provides contextual information about page hierarchy.
/contextmenu: ContextMenu displays an overlay menu to display actions related to an element.
/dock: Dock is a navigation component consisting of menuitems.
/menu: Menu displays a list of items in vertical orientation.
/menubar: Menubar also known as Navbar, is a horizontal menu component.
/megamenu: MegaMenu is a navigation component that displays submenus and content in columns.
/panelmenu: PanelMenu is a hybrid of accordion-tree components.
/tieredmenu: TieredMenu displays submenus in nested overlays.
/message: Message component is used to display inline messages.
/toast: Toast is used to display messages in an overlay.
/carousel: Carousel is a content slider featuring various customization options.
/galleria: Galleria is a content gallery component.
/image: Displays a single image with preview and tranformation options.
/imagecompare: Compare two images side by side with a slider.
/animateonscroll: AnimateOnScroll is used to apply animations to elements when entering or leaving the viewport during scrolling.
/avatar: Avatar represents people using icons, labels and images.
/badge: Badge is a small status indicator for another element.
/blockui: BlockUI can either block other components or the whole page.
/chip: Chip represents entities using icons, labels and images.
/focustrap: Focus Trap keeps focus within a certain DOM element while tabbing.
/fluid: Fluid is a layout component to make descendant components span full width of their container.
/inplace: Inplace provides an easy to do editing and display at the same time where clicking the output displays the actual content.
/metergroup: MeterGroup displays scalar measurements within a known range.
/progressbar: ProgressBar is a process status indicator.
/progressspinner: ProgressSpinner is a process status indicator.
/scrolltop: ScrollTop gets displayed after a certain scroll position and used to navigates to the top of the page quickly.
/skeleton: Skeleton is a placeholder to display instead of the actual content.
/ripple: Ripple directive adds ripple effect to the host element.
/styleclass: StyleClass manages css classes declaratively to during enter/leave animations or just to toggle classes on an element.
/tag: Tag component is used to categorize content.
/terminal: Terminal is a text based user interface.
